name: myfitnesspal
description: Estimate attached food photos and read or update MyFitnessPal diary entries, foods, water, measurements, goals and fasting.

interface.shortDescription: Estimate food photos and manage MyFitnessPal
interface.longDescription: Discover all tools and input schemas with get_myfitnesspal_tool_guide. Use estimate_food_from_attachment for attached or pasted ChatGPT photos. Read diaries and base goals, match foods and servings, write requested changes and read back. Verification status is available through get_sdk_capabilities.
defaultPrompt: Estimate the food in this attached photo
Log 104 g of cooked chicken breast for lunch
Summarize my nutrition over the last week
Show my food diary for yesterday
